name: Wolf Pack

items.name: Harry Prey
items.text: The wolf pack focuses all their efforts on biting a single adjacent foe, who takes 4d6+8 piercing damage (DC 21 basic Reflex save save). If the creature fails this saving throw, the wolf pack can immediately attempt an Athletics check to trip the creature.

items.name: Pack Hunt
items.text:
1 to 3

---
The wolves work together to fell their opponents. Each enemy within a 5-foot emanation attempts a DC 21 basic Reflex save save. A creature who is Prone is Clumsy 2 for this attack. The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 1d6+1 piercing damage

2 2d6+7 piercing damage

3 2d6+11 piercing damage

text: Though wolf packs can be a menace to farming communities that rely on livestock, they prefer not to go after humanoids or other dangerous foes. However, hungry packs don't have the luxury of being cautious.
